description:
## Author Notes

Following up on the meta device fix for trunc_normal_, added smoke tests for all other functions. And fixed the ones that failed. Pretty safe PR.

## Agent Notes

Add early returns for meta tensors in `dirac_`, `orthogonal_`, and `sparse_` (matching the pattern from `trunc_normal_` in #176240), and add smoke tests that cover every public init function on meta device and with 0-element tensors across all devices.

The other init methods (`uniform_`, `normal_`, `constant_`, `ones_`, `zeros_`, `eye_`, `xavier_uniform_`, `xavier_normal_`, `kaiming_uniform_`, `kaiming_normal_`) already work on meta because their underlying primitives handle meta tensors natively through dispatch.

Authored with Claude.
title: [nn] Support meta device and 0-element tensors in all init methods
